summary: RE-PIN after a clean rebase onto adaea5c1 (main after #841 merged). RE-VERIFIED, NOT RE-STAMPED: I recomputed git patch-id --stable myself and got d8034a0e5e175f2e5c901f27a3e32416a9b67996, identical to the value at both prior heads 5fac14d1 and 086b4d3c; confirmed adaea5c1 is an ancestor of 4eda577c AND is the current main tip; and confirmed all 12 commits carry a single recognised agent marker. NOTE ON MY OWN CHECK, recorded because a wrong method that happens to agree is still wrong: my first marker grep returned 0 of 12 and was MY pattern defect - it matched 'codex' immediately after the colon while the actual trailer reads 'Co-Authored-By: OpenAI Codex'. The commits were always correctly marked; the reporting agent's claim was accurate and my contradiction of it was not. SUBSTANCE CARRIED FORWARD UNCHANGED from the 086b4d3c pin. ACCEPT. Schedules the D6 fan-out outcome acceptance report. THE BLOCKING ITEM IS CLOSED BY EXECUTION: B1, the mid-install rollback gap, proven at three widely separated injection points - in every one the on-disk artifact SHA stayed in sync with the crontab-armed SHA, via a single EXIT trap (INS:142) plus a transaction flag raised after backups and before the first install (INS:184) and lowered on the last line (INS:296), unwinding in reverse: crontab from its pre-image verified with cmp -s, then check.py, then cron.py. THREE MUTANTS ARE COVERED BY INSPECTION, NOT BY AN EXECUTED MUTATION RUN - the run was killed for wall-clock time at the operator's instruction after a prior harness had a restore bug that contaminated its own baseline. M1, whole-line schedule matching (grep -Fxc to -Fc): a four-way controlled set on one variable at test lines 879/882/885/889 - absent, present, duplicated, and critically COMMENTED, which -Fc accepts and -Fxc rejects, with the positive control adjacent. M2, runtime import replaced by compile(): a parametrized pair at 1651-1652 supplying a module-scope raise RuntimeError AND an import producing ModuleNotFoundError, neither of which compile() catches, so unlike the SyntaxError-only case from round 10 the kill is not incidental. M3, moving the preservation check after the crontab write: test_lossy_successful_awk_is_refused_before_root_crontab_is_written at 1531, which names the ordering property directly. NOT MEASURED, stated so it cannot decay into a pass: no mutant was executed against a baseline, so what is established is that a named test exists whose asserted input distinguishes the mutated behaviour - not an observed red. A well-aimed test can still be vacuous in a way only execution reveals; that residue is accepted deliberately on scope grounds, not overlooked. SCOPE JUSTIFYING IT: ops-only, restarts no service, invoked by hand, and the one blocking harm is the item that IS executed-proven.
